tokens.npc_dota_hero_naga_siren_bio:
Among the high-sworn of the Slithereen Guard there is a solemn vow oft repeated before battle: No Slithereen may fail. In truth, these words are equal parts oath and enforceable covenant, for those who fall short of their duty are banished from the order. To fail is to be other than Slithereen.

Once most highly esteemed of her race, Slithice for many years commanded a battalion of her fellows, using her formidable voice as her greatest weapon. Powerful, sinuous, serpentine, she led her deadly Guard in defense of the Deep Ones, and the great wealth of the sunken cities. But in the final battle of Crey, her forces were driven back by a marauding army of levianths intent on finding tribute for their god Maelrawn. After the long and bloody onslaught, as the bodies were cleared from the sunken halls, a single jeweled chalice was found missing from the trove. Of her hundred Guard, only a handful survived, but their bravery and sacrifice were of little consequence. What mattered was that treasure was taken. Honor destroyed. And so Naga Siren was cast out. Banished to search for the stolen chalice. Though she might add a hundred times her weight to the golden trove, she is doomed to live apart until that day she returns that which was taken. For no amount of gold is equal in honor to the honor she lost.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_naga_siren_hype: Sending squads of mirrored clones against her foes, Naga Siren ensnares and slays enemies as she leads her forces to victory. With the sound of her voice, she disables nearby foes to spring an ambush or crafting a hasty escape.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_naga_siren_npedesc1: Able to capitivate and disable enemies with her song

qualifications.raw:
Increases cast range and net projectile speed.

Applies Break upon projectile impact, and enables unit-targeting and affecting debuff immune units.
Now applies all ability effects normally on debuff immune units.

* This {{M|sub-ability}} in the {{Spellslot|4|5}}.

* Requires a unit to be affected by {{A|Naga Siren|Ensnare}} to be cast.
** There is no limit to how many units can be moved by Reel In. 

* Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|naga_siren_reel_in}} on the Ensnared-affected unit, with the following ability effects:
** [[Movement speed#Set Movement Speed|Sets]] the Ensnared unit's {{M|movement speed}} and applies a non-disabling {{M|forced movement}} to move it toward Naga while {{M|channeling}}.
** The set movement speed does not adapt to the Ensnared unit's position when affected by the following sources:
*** Other {{M|forced movement|x}} sources.
*** {{M|Teleport}} sources.
** {{M|Phase movement}}.

* Upon reaching the min distance, the Ensnared unit is no longer moved.

* Affects the following units:
** {{M|Couriers}}
** {{M|Invulnerable}} units, specifically affected by {{M|sleep}} sources.

* Does not affect the following units:
** {{M|Hidden}} units, except when the unit becomes hidden while already being moved.
** {{M|True Sight immune}} units.
** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
** The {{A|Monkey King|Tree Dance}} unit.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_naga_siren
data.bio_loc:
Among the high-sworn of the Slithereen Guard there is a solemn vow oft repeated before battle: No Slithereen may fail. In truth, these words are equal parts oath and enforceable covenant, for those who fall short of their duty are banished from the order. To fail is to be other than Slithereen.

Once most highly esteemed of her race, Slithice for many years commanded a battalion of her fellows, using her formidable voice as her greatest weapon. Powerful, sinuous, serpentine, she led her deadly Guard in defense of the Deep Ones, and the great wealth of the sunken cities. But in the final battle of Crey, her forces were driven back by a marauding army of levianths intent on finding tribute for their god Maelrawn. After the long and bloody onslaught, as the bodies were cleared from the sunken halls, a single jeweled chalice was found missing from the trove. Of her hundred Guard, only a handful survived, but their bravery and sacrifice were of little consequence. What mattered was that treasure was taken. Honor destroyed. And so Naga Siren was cast out. Banished to search for the stolen chalice. Though she might add a hundred times her weight to the golden trove, she is doomed to live apart until that day she returns that which was taken. For no amount of gold is equal in honor to the honor she lost.
data.hype_loc: Sending squads of mirrored clones against her foes, Naga Siren ensnares and slays enemies as she leads her forces to victory. With the sound of her voice, she disables nearby foes to spring an ambush or crafting a hasty escape.
data.npe_desc_loc: Able to capitivate and disable enemies with her song
